clue.text: A line written by clever US diplomat

indicators.note: something written beside another thing sits next to it, so the pieces are placed side by side

parts.note: L is the standard abbreviation for line

explanation.surface: A clever American diplomat pens a line of text.
explanation.walkthrough: Madeleine ALBRIGHT was US Secretary of State under Clinton.
explanation.definitionFit: Madeleine Albright served as US ambassador to the UN and Secretary of State, so she is an example of an American diplomat.

clue.text: Player's agent ignoring fine

indicators.note: to ignore something is to leave it out, so a letter is dropped

parts.note: a factor is an agent who does business on another's behalf
F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: A performer's agent turns a blind eye to a penalty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Player's agent' reads as one phrase, but the 's is 'is' linking definition to wordplay; FACTOR loses its F.
explanation.definitionFit: A player in a theatre company performs roles, which is exactly what an actor does.

clue.text: Steps taken to control a star

parts.note: to boss is to control or order about
a nova is a star that suddenly brightens

explanation.surface: Measures are adopted to manage a celebrity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Steps' seems to mean measures taken, but it means dance steps: the BOSSA NOVA is a Brazilian dance.
explanation.definitionFit: The bossa nova is a Brazilian dance, and a dance is a set sequence of steps.

clue.text: Disinclination to act shown by one with damaged retina

indicators.note: damaged letters are knocked out of shape and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone with an eye injury is reluctant to do anything.
explanation.definitionFit: Inertia is sluggish inactivity, a lack of will or energy to get moving.

clue.text: Scary place sought, to include a hospital by river?

indicators.note: by means next to, so the following pieces are set alongside
one word is made to include another, so it wraps around it

parts.note: H is the map symbol for hospital
the Ouse is a common English river name

explanation.surface: Someone searches for a frightening spot and asks if a riverside hospital counts.
explanation.walkthrough: A goes inside HUNTED to make HAUNTED; the Ouse is a river in Yorkshire and another in East Anglia.
explanation.definitionFit: A haunted house, supposedly visited by ghosts, is the classic frightening location.

clue.text: Beginning to tour upper-class house

indicators.note: to tour something is to go round it, so one word goes around another

parts.note: U is the old label for upper-class usage

explanation.surface: Starting a visit round an aristocratic mansion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beginning to tour' looks like a first-letter instruction, but Beginning is START, which goes round U. The house is a royal dynasty, not a building.
explanation.definitionFit: The Stuarts were a royal dynasty, and a ruling family is called a house.

clue.text: A live TV broadcast from a city on the Mediterranean coast

definitions.text: a city on the Mediterranean coast

indicators.note: broadcast also means scattered, as seed is, so the letters are spread and reset

explanation.surface: A television programme transmitted as it happens from a seaside city.
explanation.definitionFit: Tel Aviv is Israel's main coastal city, on the eastern shore of the Mediterranean Sea.

clue.text: Sign of tooth decay? Canine needs to be extracted

indicators.note: extracting removes something, as a dentist pulls a tooth, so a letter is taken out

parts.note: caries is the dental term for decay
C stands for a canine tooth in dental notation

explanation.surface: A symptom of rotting teeth: the eye-tooth will have to come out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sign of tooth decay' reads as a symptom; 'Sign' alone is the definition, a sign of the zodiac.
explanation.definitionFit: Aries, the Ram, is the first sign of the zodiac.

clue.text: Assess performance in River Dee initially, then short river

indicators.note: something short is cut off before its end, so the last letter goes

parts.note: the Test is a river in Hampshire

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: Judging a rower's showing on the River Dee and then on a little stream.
explanation.walkthrough: 'River Dee' reads as one name, but River is the Test, a Hampshire trout river, and Dee supplies only its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A test drive is a trial run of a car to judge how well it handles.

clue.text: Showing good aesthetic judgement in refurbished flat — suite I removed

indicators.note: a refurbished place has been done up and rearranged
removed means taken away, so one letter is dropped

parts.note: the letter to be taken out

explanation.surface: A flat that has been redone with the three-piece suite gone shows good taste.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasteful means having or showing refined, discerning taste in style and decoration.

clue.text: Prairies: maps I collected

indicators.note: things collected are gathered in, so one word takes another inside it

explanation.surface: Someone boasts of the charts of the grasslands they have amassed.
explanation.definitionFit: Prairies are wide flat grasslands, and such expanses of open level land are called plains.

clue.text: Wonky gyroscope lad fixed for actress

indicators.note: something wonky is crooked or out of true, so these letters are out of order

explanation.surface: A boy repairs a faulty spinning toy for a performer.
explanation.walkthrough: Gladys Cooper was an English stage and screen actress, Oscar-nominated for Now, Voyager and My Fair Lady.
explanation.definitionFit: Dame Gladys Cooper was a celebrated English actress, so she is an example of one.

clue.text: For this one needs right type of oven

definitions.text: For this one needs right type of oven

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for right
an oast is a kiln for drying hops

explanation.surface: A cook's reminder that this dish requires the correct kind of oven.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition, and it also builds the answer from R and OAST; an oast house is the cone-roofed kiln seen in Kent hop country.
explanation.definitionFit: Roasting meat or vegetables is cooking done in an oven, so the dish depends on the appliance.

clue.text: Shown on the box, Elvis teed off

indicators.note: off means gone bad or awry, so the letters are out of their proper order

explanation.surface: Elvis Presley was filmed for television hitting a golf drive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Teed off' reads as golf or annoyance; off is the anagram signal. The box is British slang for television.
explanation.definitionFit: Shown on the box means broadcast on television, which is what televised means.

clue.text: Italian painter ordered vindaloo and rice

indicators.note: to be ordered is to be put in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A Renaissance artist asks for a curry takeaway with rice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ordered' reads as asking for food at a restaurant, but it signals rearrangement; vindaloo is a fiery curry.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonardo da Vinci, painter of the Mona Lisa, was a Renaissance master from Italy.

clue.text: Revised title includes second Kipling poem with a recurring theme

indicators.note: to include something is to hold it inside, so one piece goes within another
a revised text has been reworked, so its letters are reshuffled

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a short time
If is Rudyard Kipling's best-known poem

explanation.surface: A poem's reworked heading contains a stanza whose idea keeps coming back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Second' wants to be the second letter of something; it is a short moment instead. Leitmotif is a German term from Wagner's operas.
explanation.definitionFit: A leitmotif is a melody or idea that keeps returning through a musical or literary work.

clue.text: Without equal, nothing contains cricket side on level above English

indicators.note: to contain is to hold within, so one word surrounds the rest
in a down entry, above means placed before, so one piece comes ahead of the next

parts.note: the on side is one half of a cricket field, also called leg side
on a par means level or equal
E is the abbreviation for English

explanation.surface: A cricket team with no match is level with the English side above it.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the field is divided into the on side and the off side, so 'cricket side' can be either word.
explanation.definitionFit: Nonpareil is a French loan meaning having no match, unrivalled.

clue.text: Certainly at home, everyone's against discipline at school

parts.note: all means everyone; the 's is just 'is'
con means against, as in pros and cons
science is a school subject, and a subject of study is a discipline

explanation.surface: At home, the whole family rails against school punishment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Discipline' suggests punishment, but here it is a field of study.
explanation.definitionFit: In all conscience is an idiom meaning truly, by any fair standard, close to certainly.

clue.text: Omitted the French female solicitor

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for female
a tout is one who solicits custom, as a ticket tout does

explanation.surface: A French woman lawyer has been passed over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solicitor' suggests a British lawyer, but here it is someone who solicits business: a tout, like a ticket tout selling spare tickets.
explanation.definitionFit: Left out means excluded or not included, the same as omitted.

clue.text: I do it wrongly, in charge, being silly

indicators.note: doing something wrongly puts it out of order, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: IC is the abbreviation for in charge

explanation.surface: A boss confesses to getting things wrong and acting foolishly.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiotic means very stupid or foolish, a stronger synonym for silly.

clue.text: Nothing needs to be added to clear statement of policy

indicators.note: adding one thing to another tacks it on, so it is joined at the end

explanation.surface: Nothing must be added to make a political programme clear.
explanation.definitionFit: A manifesto is a party's published declaration of its aims and policies.

clue.text: Take care of slow-moving shark

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to look after someone who is ill
second meaning: a sluggish bottom-dwelling shark of warm seas

explanation.surface: Look after a sluggish shark.
explanation.definitionFit: To nurse is to tend a patient, and the nurse shark is a docile, slow species.

clue.text: Jacob's father's saving scheme account

parts.note: an ISA is a UK individual savings account
AC is the abbreviation for account

explanation.surface: The patriarch's savings plan account.
explanation.walkthrough: The second 's is 'is'. An ISA is a British tax-free savings account.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Isaac and Rebekah are the parents of the twins Jacob and Esau.

clue.text: Arrive on time with one of Santa's reindeer

indicators.note: in a down entry, one thing on another sits above it, so the pieces are stacked in order

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Turn up punctually with a sleigh-puller.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arrive on time' reads as punctuality; on just puts one piece above the other.
explanation.definitionFit: Comet is named among Santa's reindeer in the poem A Visit from St Nicholas.

clue.text: Brat's mistake after start of tantrum

indicators.note: after means following, so one piece is placed behind another
the start of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A spoilt child's blunder follows a fit of rage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brat's' looks possessive, but the 's is 'is' joining definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A terror is informal for a badly behaved child, as in a little terror.

clue.text: Ahead, master swimming against the current

parts.note: up means ahead, as in two goals up

indicators.note: swimming suggests things moving about loosely, so the letters drift into a new order

explanation.surface: A champion swimmer, in the lead, battles a strong flow.
explanation.definitionFit: Going upstream means travelling toward a river's source, against the direction the water flows.

clue.text: Feast I prepared for carnival

indicators.note: something prepared has been made up from ingredients, so the letters are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: I cooked a banquet for the festival.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiesta is a festive celebration, Spanish in origin, much like a carnival.

clue.text: Couple hired band

explanation.surface: A pair of newlyweds booked a group of musicians.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Band' suggests musicians, but it is a ring of metal worn round the wrist.
explanation.definitionFit: A bracelet is an ornamental band worn around the wrist.
